claims.conclusion: Position population established from the protocol query and wallet control evidence.
claims.statement: DemoCo holds three DeFi positions in the treasury-defi wallet it controls: a DemoSwap LP position, a DemoLend ETH deposit and 10 WBTC-D.

claims.conclusion: Unit of account and derecognition concluded per position.
claims.statement: The LP contribution and the lending deposit surrendered control and were derecognized for new assets; the wrapped token is a claim on the custodian, not a crypto asset under ASC 350-60.

claims.conclusion: Valuation recomputes and ties to the register.
claims.statement: At 2026-06-30 the positions are valued at 1,125,000 USD (LP), 250,000 USD (lending claim) and 650,000 USD (wrapped BTC), 2,025,000 USD in total, at prices evidenced on that date.
The LP and wrapped tokens are indefinite-lived intangibles under ASC 350-30; the lending claim is measured at the fair value of the ETH owed with an ASC 326 assessment.

claims.conclusion: Presentation and disclosure per ASC 350-30-50, ASC 275-10-50 and ASC 820-10-50.
claims.statement: The positions, the protocols' custody of the underlyings, the measurement bases and the concentration in one wallet are disclosed.
